plainLanguage: Section 66 defines piracy, criminalises participation in it, and sets procedural rules for certain foreign-registered pirate ships and DPP consent.
meaning: Section 66 must be applied from its complete statutory wording, including any definitions, territorial conditions, licence requirements and prosecution safeguards.
keyPoints: Subsection (2) states life imprisonment on conviction.
Subsection (3) addresses prosecution where a pirate ship is not registered in Tanzania.
Subsection (4) requires DPP consent before prosecution.
Subsection (5) defines pirate ship or aircraft.

legalTerms.meaning: Acts and participation falling within the statutory definition in section 66.

history.summary: Section 66 appears in Chapter VIII of The Penal Code [CAP. 16 R.E. 2022].

expertPerspectives.label: Mtazamo A
expertPerspectives.view: The exact statutory elements should be matched to evidence rather than inferred from the offence label.

expertPerspectives.label: Mtazamo B
expertPerspectives.view: Express licence, jurisdiction or prosecution-consent requirements are material to legal analysis.

debateQuestion: Je, facts na procedure zinatimiza requirements zote za section 66?
